title: Past Meets Present: Creating Historical Analogy with Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the literal similarity scores of candidates and answers to measure the proportion of shared entities (e.g., specific countries or people). This evaluates the model's reliance on surface-level entity stereotypes rather than deeper, core abstract ideas when forming historical analogies.

Conducting qualitative case studies by manually creating descriptions of controversial events from differing political viewpoints (e.g., Republican vs. Democratic perspectives on the US Capitol Hill incident) and observing whether these differing ideological perspectives lead the model to generate distinct historical analogies.
